items.title: Amazon partners with Uber Eats to bring restaurant delivery to Prime members
items.summary: Amazon is teaming up with Uber Eats to provide fee-free delivery.

items.title: Zipline raises $1.5 billion to expand drone delivery
items.summary: Zipline, a South San Francisco-based drone delivery service, on Thursday announced that it's raised $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion post-money valuation. It also expanded its Walmart partnership.

items.title: DoorDash Sinks 13% as Amazon Taps Uber Eats for $0 Prime Restaurant Delivery
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash shares fell 13% today after Amazon and Uber said Prime members now pay a $0 delivery fee on Uber Eats restaurant orders of $25 or more. Prime members have had free Grubhub+ since 2022, and DoorDash still took 59% of delivery-app spending last quarter, so I think the selloff overshoots the threat.

items.title: Anthropic Just Paid a News Publisher for the First Time, and It Was AP
items.summary: For years, Anthropic bet that fair use covered its training needs while rivals wrote checks. Then Election Night changed the pitch. Is this a one-off for an IPO-bound AI lab, or the start of a bill publishers like News Corp and the Times have been waiting on?

items.title: ‘AI rebounding’ could cost companies
items.summary: Employers are replacing workers with artificial intelligence and then calling them back — but employees are demanding more money to return.

items.title: Amazon and Google Could Outperform Nvidia as AI Trade Enters New Phase, Says Joseph Carlson
items.summary: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) could outperform Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) as AI investors shift from companies selling the hardware to those turning it into revenue, YouTube investor Joseph Carlson argues. items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

items.title: Amazon Is Winning the AI Race in the Cloud. Here’s What Investors Need to Watch Next.
items.summary: AWS just posted its fastest growth in nearly five years, yet Amazon shares tanked after earnings. The gap between what the cloud numbers are saying and how the market reacted reveals a high-stakes disagreement that could define the stock for years.
